title: PowerRename - Include Files / Folders / Subfolders buttons do not work

judgment.rationale: The report describes the same PowerRename item-type inclusion controls failing to change the preview as the still-open #46689 report. The live discussion also contains an automated triage summary identifying #46689 as a near-identical duplicate. Because the two reports cover the same controls and expected behavior, a second fix investigation should not be started; the maintainer should consolidate this report with #46689.
evidence: The reporter says the Include files, Include folders, and Include subfolders controls appear to do nothing in PowerRename 0.98.0.0 from the Microsoft Store.
The expected behavior is for those controls to change which files, folders, and subfolders appear in the rename selection; the actual behavior is that the selection remains unchanged.
The live automated triage comment explicitly identifies open issue #46689 as a nearly identical report with the same three controls and the same failure pattern.
Issue #46689 is open, labeled Issue-Bug and Product-PowerRename, and reports the same controls flashing without changing the selected items in PowerRename 0.98.1.
No assignee, linked pull request, or other linked fix work is present in the live issue timeline for #50454.
judgment.recommended_action: Link #50454 to #46689 as a duplicate and continue any fix ownership or reproduction work from the existing PowerRename issue rather than opening a competing fix.

fix_assessment.rationale: A separate PowerRename code fix is not applicable to this report because the same control-level failure is already tracked by open issue #46689. The current evidence supports duplicate consolidation, not a competing implementation plan.

issue_context.summary: PowerRename's Include files, Include folders, and Include subfolders controls do not alter the rename preview for a folder-heavy selection. The public report and live triage comment match the existing open #46689 report, so this item should be consolidated rather than independently designed.
known_information: The reporter is using PowerToys 0.98.0.0 from the Microsoft Store on Windows 11 Home 64-bit, build 26200.
The reporter selected multiple folders containing nested folders and files and observed that all contents remained included.
The issue body says each of the three controls appears to do nothing and states that the right-side preview remains unchanged.
The issue has Issue-Bug, Product-PowerRename, and Needs-Triage labels and no assignee.
The only live comment is an automated triage comment recommending an update to 0.101.2362.0 and identifying #46689 as a nearly identical report.
Issue #46689 is open and reports the same three PowerRename controls failing in version 0.98.1.
The current PowerRename XAML names the controls toggleButton_includeFiles, toggleButton_includeFolders, and toggleButton_includeSubfolders.
The current PowerRename UI test suite contains ExcludingFilesFoldersAndSubfolderItemsFiltersTheRename, which exercises all three controls and checks that preview entries are removed and restored.
inferences: The two issues are very likely duplicates because they identify the same controls, same unchanged-preview symptom, and same expected filtering behavior across adjacent 0.98 releases.

The current test coverage suggests the intended behavior is already explicitly defined in the repository, but it does not by itself prove whether the reporter's old 0.98.0 build contains the same regression or whether a later build fixed it.

Updating to the current stable release may distinguish an already-fixed old-release defect from a still-present defect, but it is not needed before linking the duplicate reports because the public symptoms already match.
issue_context.analysis: The issue is sufficiently specific to compare without requesting logs: it names the exact controls, gives a repeatable folder/file selection scenario, and describes the unchanged preview. The automated triage comment independently found #46689, whose body describes the same controls flashing without changing the selection. Code inspection confirms the controls are the same PowerRename UI elements and that the repository has focused UI coverage for excluding files, folders, and nested subfolder items. This supports a duplicate_or_handled judgment and a maintainer-facing duplicate-link comment, with no new fix design.
initial_investigation: Compared the full #50454 body and comments with #46689; both report the Include files, Include folders, and Include subfolders controls failing to filter the PowerRename preview, and both are open PowerRename bug reports.

Searched the live PowerRename code: MainWindow.xaml defines toggleButton_includeFiles, toggleButton_includeFolders, and toggleButton_includeSubfolders; MainWindow.xaml.cpp contains the corresponding exclusion-flag handling.
Reviewed the current PowerRename UI tests: PowerRenameOptionsTests.cs includes ExcludingFilesFoldersAndSubfolderItemsFiltersTheRename, which verifies each exclusion independently and in combination.
Reviewed recent history for MainWindow.xaml.cpp; no issue-specific fix or linked work was identified from the recent file history returned by GitHub.
Reviewed the #50454 timeline: only label, mention, subscription, and automated-triage activity is present; no assignee or linked work item appears.

actions.label: Link duplicate #46689
actions.note: The report matches the existing open PowerRename bug and should be consolidated without starting duplicate fix work.

comment.body: Thanks for the detailed reproduction and for identifying the exact PowerRename controls involved. This appears to duplicate the still-open issue #46689, which reports the same Include files, Include folders, and Include subfolders buttons leaving the rename selection unchanged. Please consolidate this report with #46689 so the PowerRename fix and any release verification are tracked in one place.
